sourceObservations: The source is immediately identifiable as a closed wooden barrel: a planked oval-looking lid in the registered projection, a broad bulging stave body and two narrow navy hoops.
Its very bright, almost uniform lemon-yellow lid loses soft material volume; thin orange lid divisions remain visible but mostly read as flat lines.
The shoulder/body show pronounced planar light-to-dark changes, and the lower staves become much darker and muddier than the honey upper wood.
The hoops preserve strong navy contrast but have hard thin edges and limited soft material volume.
targetObservations: The reskin preserves the recognizable honey/gold wood and navy hoop identity while making the lid planks, shoulder blocks and barrel staves feel more softly modeled.
Warm local wood variation, soft seam depth and restrained rounded edge transitions are the useful style signal.
The hoops have more explicit dimensional edges and blue accents. Exact gloss, tiny wood grain, bright edge fringe and target padding/scale drift are not success requirements.
Only the shown facing is a direct style reference; unseen native facings should be judged for coherent continuation without inventing unseen target details.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: A colored honey lid and warm readable lower staves with broad soft volume instead of a flat bright top and muddy bottom.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.location: lid plank divisions, barrel shoulder, stave boundaries and hoops
rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Tidy softened seams and edge transitions that strengthen the existing barrel construction at intended size without changing lid/stave identity or adding noise.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.location: all native rotations and repeated preview
rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: A coherent navy/honey material treatment without directional shadow, dark dead spots, clipping or registration changes.

technicalEvidence.knownContract: Four actual native N/E/S/W rotations; 384 x 704 source captures; 192 x 352 logical frame; [96, 248] logical root; one-cell footprint; one static frame and 12 fps metadata.
technicalEvidence.limits: The initial snapshot and target alone do not certify camera, geometry, registration, four native views, lighting symmetry or alpha-edge quality on multiple backgrounds. Candidate packet and native validation are required.
